description: For a buyer-held PRIVATE receipt ID from a previous KEVAREMESH native owned-API purchase. Check payment and delivery, reconcile an already authorized Base USDC transaction on-chain with the merchant, or retrieve the original result from a 24-hour encrypted cache. Reconciliation can confirm EXISTING settlement only and cannot sign, charge or create a new payment. Keep receipt and transaction details private.

transaction_hash.description: Optional verified prior Base transaction hash for reconcile mode only; never a wallet signing request.

name: kevaremesh_recover_owned_result
title: Recover already purchased KEVAREMESH API output (NO NEW PAYMENT)
